name: RAF Croughton
tagline: Home of the 422nd Air Base Group, which also supports RAF Fairford and RAF Welford.
coords_source: approximate point on the installation, from public maps
_note: Written on 2026-11-21 by scripts/guides/write_missed_guides.py from the official pages named in each section. Not in the first installation list; added after the missed-bases check.

data.Branch: U.S. Air Force (422nd Air Base Group)
data.Location: Croughton, England; RAF Fairford about 47 miles and RAF Welford about 46 miles away

source.label: Military OneSource, RAF Croughton, RAF Fairford

sections.title: Mission
data: The 422nd Air Base Group at RAF Croughton delivers worldwide communications, enables global strike operations and supports mission partners. Personnel at RAF Welford use RAF Croughton for their services.

source.label: Military OneSource, RAF Croughton, RAF Fairford

sections.title: Housing
data: Report to the Housing Management Office within two workdays of arrival. The office advises on Temporary Lodging Allowance, military family housing and renting in the community.

sections.title: Housing allowance (OHA, not BAH)
data: The United Kingdom is an overseas location for housing allowances. Service members who live off base receive the Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA) instead of BAH. OHA is set by rank, dependents and the actual rent, up to a ceiling, with separate amounts for utilities and move-in costs.
Check your own figures with the official OHA calculator before you sign a lease.

source.label: Defense Travel Management Office, Overseas Housing Allowance

intro: An overseas move has extra steps. Start these before you leave.

steps.title: Travel in civilian clothes
steps.text: All members moving to the United Kingdom travel in civilian attire.

steps.title: Leave U.S. cordless devices behind
steps.text: U.S. cordless phones and baby monitors can interfere with UK emergency radio and are illegal there.

steps.title: Report to the personnel flight
steps.text: Active duty members report in uniform on the first duty day after arrival, with their final out-processing documents.
